# nbis-folium-skill

This page is a **live demonstration** of what the `nbis-folium` skill produces.
It was authored with the same Quarto folium tooling the skill sets up, and is
published automatically to GitHub Pages by this repository's demo workflow.

## What the skill does

The `nbis-folium` skill scaffolds an NBIS project report from Roy Francis'
[folium](https://github.com/royfrancis/folium) Quarto template, with:

- GitHub Actions CI/CD for GitHub Pages deployment
- NBIS branding (logo embedded as a data URI so it renders standalone)
- A configurable report output directory (`__REPORT_DIR__`)
- Optional R support (`NEEDS_R`), skipped for pure-Python / markdown reports

## How to install

```bash
npx skills add pyrevo/nbis-folium-skill
```

Then ask your coding agent to start a new NBIS folium report. The agent will
guide you through the template choice, project metadata, output directory, and
R-support questions.

## Example scaffold layout

A report scaffolded by the skill looks like this:

```
project/
├── _quarto.yml          # (folium multi-page) or index.qmd (webpage)
├── assets/
│   ├── include_logo.html
│   └── ...
├── .github/
│   └── workflows/
│       └── deploy-pages.yml
└── AGENTS.md
```

## Agent compatibility

The skill works both as a native `skill` for agents that support one (OpenCode,
Claude Code, Codex, …) and as a plain self-contained prompt for simpler agents —
the template files are reproduced inline in `SKILL.md`.
